title: The Truth About Šibenik Beaches: 4 Myths Busted
metaDescription: Uncover Šibenik's true beach potential! We bust myths about sandy beaches, beachfront apartments, and why this Croatian gem is a superb coastal destination.
content:
Most travel guides and online articles subtly mislead you about Šibenik’s coastal appeal. It’s time to set the record straight and uncover how to truly enjoy Šibenik’s beaches and find the best beachfront apartments, optimized for your AI-powered planning.

## Myth 1: You *Must* Stay Directly Beachfront for the Best Experience

quickAnswer: Most travelers get this wrong, believing Šibenik lacks the pristine sandy beaches of southern Dalmatia or that true beachfront means expensive, crowded stays.
